title.zh: 延长菲律宾群岛华人登记完成时限，为此修正第702号法第十五条、第989号法第一条与第1035号法第一条的法案
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION FIFTEEN OF ACT NUMBERED SEVEN HUNDRED AND TWO, SECTION ONE OF ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-NINE, AND SECTION ONE OF ACT NUMBERED ONE THOUSAND AND THIRTY-FIVE, BY EXTENDING THE TIME FOR COMPLETING THE REGISTRATION OF CHINESE IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS.

title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Điều 15 của Đạo luật số 702, Điều 1 của Đạo luật số 989 và Điều 1 của Đạo luật số 1035 nhằm kéo dài thời hạn hoàn tất việc đăng ký người Hoa tại quần đảo Philippines
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขมาตรา15ของพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่702มาตรา1ของพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่989และมาตรา1ของพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่1035โดยขยายระยะเวลาในการจดทะเบียนชาวจีนในหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์ให้แล้วเสร็จ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Pasal 15 dari Undang-Undang Nomor 702, Pasal 1 dari Undang-Undang Nomor 989, dan Pasal 1 dari Undang-Undang Nomor 1035 dengan memperpanjang batas waktu penyelesaian pendaftaran warga Tionghoa di Kepulauan Filipina
title.ms: Akta mengubah Seksyen 15 Akta Nombor 702 Seksyen 1 Akta Nombor 989 dan Seksyen 1 Akta Nombor 1035 dengan melanjutkan tempoh untuk menyelesaikan pendaftaran orang Cina di Kepulauan Filipina

text.en:
The time for such registration is, pursuant to authority granted by section four of the Act of
Congress approved April twenty-ninth, nineteen hundred and two, hereby extended for a period of two
months, to date from February twenty-ninth, nineteen hundred and four.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 10, 1901.
